# Billing

## Payment Methods

We accept Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. You can update your payment method in your account settings under the Billing section.

## Refunds

Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days. To request a refund, contact our support team with your order number.

If your refund has not been processed after 10 business days, please contact us again and we will escalate the issue.
